name: Protected Fresh Executable Holdout
mechanism: Separates visible development, candidate selection, hidden promotion and red-team tasks with immutable manifests, access control and duplicate checks.
use_when: Repeated optimization can overfit visible evaluations
Generalization or production promotion claims are being made
avoid_when: The same optimizer receives holdout-level feedback repeatedly
Tasks cannot be versioned reset or checked for leakage
expected_effects: Reduced selection bias and benchmark overfitting
Auditable separation of development and promotion evidence
failure_modes: Holdout scores leak into mutation feedback
